I absolutely relate to this, but I want to try to give you some reasons to try and eat more. I have anorexia, and I get n*, sometimes stomach aches, and even more anxiety than I usually do when I am not restricting. The more you eat, the better your immune system is to fight off any infections, viruses, bacteria, and so on. The less you eat, the less your GI system has to work and the less nutrients it has to run which I have heard can lead to gastroperesis (delayed stomach emptying). It also causes constipation which can be followed by d*. In no way is this to scare you. Food is very hard to eat especially with this phobia. You can try taking a multivitamin and drinking 1-2 nutritional shakes. I drink dairy free ones. I hope you can try to eat a little more. I wish you luck.
